tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every surface. A morning-light white with a faint leaf bias; never pure grey.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the app header and form fields.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and popovers that float above surface. Pair with elevation-2 or elevation-3.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: filter bars, quiet button fill, the track of the application status.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. 3:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: organisation names, descriptions, field hints. 6.4:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata: timestamps, counts, placeholder text. 4.6:1 or better on every surface; do not go lighter.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The brand's hope colour. Primary button fill, the logo spark, the active nav marker, the countdown when a deadline is near. Always carries on-sun text.

tokens.name: sun-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for sun buttons.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sun and sun-hover. Never white on sun.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind 'closing soon' chips, highlighted rows and the selected filter.

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the sun family on sun-soft, surface or canvas, e.g. 'Closing soon'. 5.1:1 or better.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The grounding brand colour. Logo tile, brand bands on the public site, the selected nav item, secondary filled buttons. Carries on-forest text.

tokens.name: forest-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for forest buttons.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on forest and forest-hover.

tokens.name: forest-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind kind chips (Grant, Fellowship), the tracked state and selected list rows.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons on any surface, and forest text on forest-soft. Underline on hover.

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: Celebration only: an accepted application, a first save, the logo's dot. Decorative fill, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: bloom-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind celebration moments and the 'last few days' countdown.

tokens.name: bloom-ink
tokens.usage: Text on bloom-soft and surface: 'Accepted', '2 days left'.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: saved, synced, submitted. Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind success banners and toasts.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warnings that need attention but are not errors: an unverified deadline, a stale source.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind caution banners.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only. Never for deadlines; a near deadline is sun or bloom, not red.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind error banners and the destructive confirm area.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on a critical fill (the destructive button).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices: 'Found by the discovery agent', calendar sync status.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind info banners.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset from the control. 5:1 or better on every surface; on a forest fill the offset gap keeps it visible.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and the mobile nav sheet.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Your next yes is out there
styles.usage: Public site hero only. One per page.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles on the public site and admin.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Page titles in the member app; section heads on the public site.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The countdown number and other single figures. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Group labels inside cards and forms.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Up to GHS 120,000 in equity-free funding for early-stage founders in Ghana.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: Checked 2 days ago from the official page
styles.usage: Source and verification notes, field hints.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chips and small labels. 12px is the floor.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Admin audit log, agent traces and ids.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside a card; field label to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections in the member app.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on the public site.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Public site hero padding; band padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, banners, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Public site bands and hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the countdown, avatars. Every pressable thing is a pill.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Light and close, like paper on a table in daylight.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the mobile nav sheet.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and chips with actions.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on phones and the public site.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the app and site content column.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of opportunity descriptions and legal pages.
